title: Moderating Shop Rental Increases in Heritage Precincts Such as Chinatown and Kampong Gelam
what_it_is: Moderating Shop Rental Increases in Heritage Precincts Such as Chinatown and Kampong Gelam

sections.label: Retail rents in historic districts
sections.summary: URA reports median retail rents in Kampong Gelam, Little India and Chinatown rose about 2% per annum over two years, comparable to Central Area retail and below nominal GDP growth.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: As shared recently by the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), median rents for retail spaces in historic districts of Kampong Gelam, Little India and Chinatown, including sublet arrangements, have increased at a moderate pace of around 2% per annum over the past two years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: These increases were comparable with rental increases of conventional retail space in the Central Area and lower than nominal gross domestic product (GDP) growth over the same period.

sections.label: Heritage businesses task force measures
sections.summary: The Inter-Agency Task Force for Heritage Businesses, Traditional Activities and Cultural Life introduced measures including marketing and business consultancy support under NHB's SG Heritage Business Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: The Inter-Agency Task Force for Heritage Businesses, Traditional Activities and Cultural Life has also introduced new measures, such as marketing and business consultancy support under the National Heritage Board's (NHB's) SG Heritage Business Scheme.

sections.label: Kampong Gelam lease rent increases
sections.summary: Most Kampong Gelam leases had moderate rent increases below nominal GDP growth and comparable to conventional Central Area retail spaces.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: The majority of leases in Kampong Gelam saw moderate rent increases below that of nominal GDP growth and comparable to the increases of conventional retail spaces in the Central Area.

sections.label: Higher Kampong Gelam shophouse rents
sections.summary: While median Kampong Gelam shophouse rents rose moderately, a small proportion of leases signed between 2023 and 2025 saw increases of 25% or higher.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: While the median rents of the historic shophouses in Kampong Gelam increased at a moderate pace, there was also a small proportion of leases signed between 2023 and 2025 which did see higher rental increases of 25% or higher.

sections.label: Businesses designated under scheme
sections.summary: 42 businesses have been designated under the scheme, including 21 in Kampong Gelam and Chinatown.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Today, 42 businesses have been designated under the scheme, including 21 in Kampong Gelam and Chinatown.

sections.label: URA controls in historic districts
sections.summary: URA has controls excluding non-heritage users such as fast food restaurants, supermarkets and new bars from core areas of Kampong Gelam, Chinatown and Little India.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's question on ensuring the appropriateness of the activity within the heritage district, which is her first question, and wanting to be able to strengthen the businesses there in keeping with the intent of the heritage districts, I wish to reassure the Member that to safeguard the vibrancy of our historic districts, whether they be Kampong Gelam, Chinatown or Little India, the URA has put in place controls to exclude non-heritage users, such as fast food restaurants, supermarkets and new bars, even to the extent of ensuring the number of souvenir shops are maintained by a certain measure, from the core areas of these historic districts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: In terms of potential expansion of the space, I think the current delineation of the districts are also related to their historical significance to the community there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: But that is something we can take back and see whether the borders of the district or certainly, the activities within the district, can be further expanded and enhanced.

sections.label: Support for heritage area alliances
sections.summary: The Inter-Agency Task Force for Heritage Businesses, Traditional Activities and Cultural Life can amalgamate stakeholders' interests and concerns to move forward.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: My question is whether there will be further support, going forward, to work with the Kampong Gelam Alliance, or other alliances for that matter, in other heritage areas, and possibly with the SME Centres to make sure that we find out the issues that they face – whether it is non-rental or rental or manpower issues – so that they can be addressed beforehand.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my Parliamentary Question reply, certainly, it is within the scope and attention of the Inter-Agency Task Force for Heritage Businesses, Traditional Activities and Cultural Life to be able to further amalgamate the interests and concerns of the diverse stakeholders, already mentioned by Ms Denise Phua earlier, to be able to understand and see how best we can move forward.

sections.label: SG Heritage Business Scheme support
sections.summary: The SG Heritage Business Scheme has looked at uplifting designated heritage businesses through marketing and consulting support.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Beyond the aspects of costs, through the work of the SG Heritage Business Scheme, they have also looked at how to uplift the businesses, specifically the designated heritage businesses, in terms of marketing as well as consulting support.
